title: J-K: Resident doctors at Government Medical College go on indefinite strike

ai.summary: Postgraduate and senior resident doctors at Government Medical College in Srinagar began an indefinite strike demanding higher stipends and parity with other states and Union Territories.

facts.claim: Postgraduate and senior resident doctors at the Government Medical College here began an indefinite strike on Friday
facts.quote: Postgraduate and senior resident doctors at the Government Medical College here began an indefinite strike on Friday,

facts.claim: The protesting doctors urged the government to address their demands immediately
facts.quote: The protesting doctors urged the government to address their demands immediately.

facts.claim: AIMSA's key demands include immediate stipend enhancement and parity for postgraduate, senior resident, DNB and MDS doctors across Jammu and Kashmir
facts.quote: AIMSA's key demands include immediate stipend enhancement and parity for postgraduate, senior resident, DNB and MDS doctors across Jammu and Kashmir,

facts.claim: They also urged the principal of GMC Srinagar to facilitate the formation of a recognised Resident Doctors' Association (RDA) to ensure proper representation of resident doctors
facts.quote: They also urged the principal of GMC Srinagar to facilitate the formation of a recognised Resident Doctors' Association (RDA) to ensure proper representation of resident doctors.

ai.background_note: Doctors in Jammu and Kashmir are striking for higher stipends and parity with other states and Union Territories, following long-standing grievances.
